response.justification: Bogdan has exceptional technical depth, open-source contributions, and broad full-stack experience, but lacks demonstrated leadership in IT architecture, UML modeling, and team management at an executive level, and his German proficiency is only basic — a critical requirement for client advisory and compliance work in a German-speaking consulting context.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack expertise across diverse languages and environments (DLang, Node.js, Linux)
Strong track record in mentoring, workshops, and dev-ops infrastructure setup
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, falling short of required C1 level
No clear evidence of UML expertise, architectural design leadership, or formal project management experience
Lacks documented experience leading teams or advising clients on security/compliance at executive level
